## Source: amazon-inspector (0d30c3584f91da98dea7065e548acd378e0c1fa8abe692bbfd20c4abb384e05e)
Package tonemaptts version 0.1.0 was scanned (6 files). No install-time network I/O, no credential or environment harvesting, no suspicious lifecycle hooks, no obfuscated payloads, and no outbound connections to attacker-controlled destinations were observed in the package contents.

## Source: kam193 (19491cfac57ebbc5106857c286eb420bb2c84f246781670579fc4311cb7d1cad)
The package belongs to a series of packages falsely advertising 'audio-analysis profiles' loader. In fact, the only purpose is to execute remote code, but the URL is not embedded in the package. It is likely a continuation of the coin-mining campaign 2026-10-voxeval which used similar wording.
